finding: Full ObserverBinding equality overbinds run-specific observer instance identity for matched causal probes. Preserve full per-instance binding digests for provenance, but factor a stable observer_method_sha256 over declared method/artifact/config/evidence semantics and compare that narrower identity across intervention/control.
counterexample: Two distinct direct-hook instances with the same method digest have different full binding digests; full-binding equality returns unmatched while method-digest equality preserves the prior causal classification. A direct-hook vs async-scraper pair has different method digests and is blocked by the method gate.
orthogonal_witness: ProbeExecutionContext matches non-intervention execution conditions; ObserverMethod matches measurement semantics. Neither substitutes for the other.
